persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a square social image with a steaming espresso on a sunny café table. Headline: “Small cup. Big energy.” Warm and simple, no other text.
bank.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Small cup. Big energy.” and no other text.
bank.Size or platform: Square social image; no particular platform.
bank.Visual style and mood: Warm, simple, sunny café scene with a steaming espresso.

messages.text: Could you make an image with a steaming espresso sitting on a sunny café table? I always like that little moment of anticipation before the first sip, so that is why this idea appealed to me. What I mean is a square social image, with the headline exactly “Small cup. Big energy.” I sometimes worry that a small idea like this will get lost when I try to explain it. Please keep the overall feeling warm and simple, and don’t include any other text.
